brief: 100 keyboard shortcuts every solo founder uses to save 10 hours a week.

slots.postLine: every solo founder should memorize today
slots.cardText: A curated list of 100 keystrokes that reclaim 10+ hours every single week.

slots.toolTagline: Fly through tabs and bookmarks without ever touching your mouse.
slots.bodyText: Memorize Ctrl+T for new tabs and Ctrl+Shift+T to resurrect closed ones instantly.
slots.feat1Text: Reopen closed tabs in one keystroke
slots.feat1Sub: Ctrl+Shift+T brings back entire windows so you never lose research.
slots.feat2Sub: Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+8 snaps to any pinned tab in milliseconds.
slots.feat3Text: Clear cache and hard refresh pages
slots.feat3Sub: Ctrl+Shift+R bypasses cached assets to load the absolute latest build.

slots.toolTagline: Format pages and databases at the speed of thought.
slots.bodyText: Use Cmd+Shift+M for comments and Cmd+Enter to toggle checkboxes without scrolling.
slots.feat1Text: Create toggle lists in seconds flat
slots.feat1Sub: Type > followed by space to spawn collapsible headers for any section.
slots.feat2Text: Jump to a new line inside a cell
slots.feat2Sub: Shift+Enter breaks lines in database cells without leaving the table view.
slots.feat3Text: Comment anywhere with a single shortcut
slots.feat3Sub: Cmd+Shift+M drops inline commentary while your cursor stays in flow.

slots.toolTagline: Edit, refactor, and navigate entire repos without lifting your hands.
slots.bodyText: Cmd+P opens any file instantly while Cmd+D selects matching words for batch edits.
slots.feat1Sub: Cmd+D stacks cursors on identical words so you refactor ten lines at once.
slots.feat2Text: Open files by name without browsing
slots.feat2Sub: Cmd+P fuzzy searches your entire project tree in under a heartbeat.
slots.feat3Text: Toggle terminal panel in half a second
slots.feat3Sub: Ctrl+` summons an integrated shell so you never leave the editor window.

slots.toolTagline: Frame, component, and export at the speed of inspiration.
slots.bodyText: Ctrl+Shift+K places images while Cmd+Option+C copies properties between any two layers.
slots.feat1Text: Copy layer styles across the canvas
slots.feat1Sub: Cmd+Option+C and V paste fills, strokes, and effects to any selected object.
slots.feat2Text: Deep select nested frames with one key
slots.feat2Sub: Ctrl+Click drills through groups and boolean layers to grab the exact node.
slots.feat3Sub: Cmd+Shift+E opens the export modal so you ship PNGs in seconds.

slots.toolTagline: Message, search, and switch channels faster than your team can scroll.
slots.bodyText: Cmd+K opens the quick switcher and Cmd+Shift+M toggles your notification status instantly.
slots.feat1Text: Jump to any channel or DM instantly
slots.feat1Sub: Cmd+K fuzzy finds conversations so you never hunt through sidebar clutter again.
slots.feat2Text: Mark everything read in one motion
slots.feat2Sub: Shift+Esc clears every unread badge and silences the red dot anxiety forever.
slots.feat3Text: Edit your last message on the fly
slots.feat3Sub: Up arrow in an empty box lets you fix typos before anyone notices.

slots.toolTagline: Command the entire operating system from the home row alone.
slots.bodyText: Cmd+Space launches Spotlight and Cmd+Tab cycles apps so you never touch the trackpad.
slots.feat1Sub: Cmd+Space finds files, apps, and calculations before your Dock even loads.
slots.feat2Sub: Cmd+Tab cycles forward while holding Shift reverses the app stack order.
slots.feat3Text: Screenshot and record your full screen
slots.feat3Sub: Cmd+Shift+5 opens the capture bar to save stills or video clips instantly.

slots.ctaBody: Reclaim ten hours every week by keeping these 100 shortcuts one keystroke away.
